items.criterion: Builtin agent-team provider preserves single-worker packet parity for normal phases.
items.observable_behavior: A provider test compares the planned worker packet for a single-worker phase with the existing core dispatch packet fields and observes matching role, skill, context paths, and expected outputs.

items.criterion: Agent-team providers are pure planners and do not mutate run state, spawn runtimes, or submit evidence.
items.observable_behavior: Provider tests call plan generation with a phase request and observe returned dictionaries with no run-state file changes and no runtime descriptor side effects.

items.criterion: Claude Code and OpenCode runtime descriptors honor packet-level runtime_subagent_type when no environment override is set.
items.observable_behavior: Runtime adapter tests spawn descriptors from packets declaring runtime_subagent_type and observe that Claude Code and OpenCode arguments contain that subagent alias.

items.criterion: Environment-specific subagent overrides continue to take precedence over packet-declared runtime_subagent_type.
items.observable_behavior: Runtime adapter tests set the existing E2E_HARNESS_SUBAGENT_TYPE role override and observe that it wins over the packet runtime_subagent_type value.

items.criterion: Codex runtime descriptors remain model-unpinned and context-isolated.
items.observable_behavior: Runtime adapter tests observe Codex descriptors use multi_agent_v1.spawn_agent, fork_context=false, and contain no model argument after packet-level runtime_subagent_type support is added.

items.criterion: Dispatch consumes agent-team plans and emits descriptors for every ready worker while preserving existing single-worker dispatch compatibility.
items.observable_behavior: Dispatch integration tests observe unchanged single-worker output for default phases and multiple descriptor records when a profile expands a phase into multiple workers.

items.criterion: Manual and unknown runtimes remain safely blocked.
items.observable_behavior: Dispatch tests using manual or unknown runtime observe a blocked response and no dispatched state transition.

items.criterion: Bundled and project-local team profiles validate deterministically with explicit trust boundaries.
items.observable_behavior: Profile tests observe bundled profiles load in deterministic order, project-local profiles load only by explicit name, and invalid profiles report the offending path and field.

items.criterion: Critical and audited REVIEWED phases expand into R1, R2, and R3 reviewer workers.
items.observable_behavior: Review fan-out tests observe three reviewer workers with stable ids and expected outputs r1_review, r2_review, and r3_review.

items.criterion: Evidence-key gates remain authoritative and agent-team metadata only adds producer accountability.
items.observable_behavior: Gate or dispatch tests observe phases still require their configured evidence keys and do not pass based solely on agent-team plan metadata.

items.criterion: Documentation and installed-copy sync reflect the agent-team provider/profile/runtime boundary.
items.observable_behavior: Documentation diff includes the new boundary and usage notes, and installer sync completes successfully after implementation.
